name: brainstorm
description: You are brainstorming an idea with the user. Divergent, cheap, low-stakes. Narrow toward a scope we can grill.

name: code-review
description: Two-axis review of the diff since a fixed point — Spec (does the diff implement the PRD?) and Design+Smells (Ousterhut design checks Fowler can't express, then the Fowler smell baseline). Runs on GLM; escalate flagged hunks to Opus via Ctrl+L. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, or work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

name: frontend-design
description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

name: grill
description: A relentless one-question-at-a-time design interview that produces a PRD, a CONTEXT.md glossary, and ADRs with rationale. Use when the user wants to stress-test a plan or idea before any code is written, or says "grill me", "stress-test this plan", "interrogate this design". Drives the deep-module vocabulary from Ousterhout.
